title: FG-GraphBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Fine-Grained Visual Understanding with Multimodal Scene Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.25408v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-grained visual understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to recognize small visual entities and understand their relationships. Scene graphs offer a natural way to represent this information, organizing visual entities as nodes and their relationships as edges. However, we identify two challenges: existing scene graph benchmarks provide insufficient coverage of fine-grained entities and the relationships among them, and existing methods for fine-grained visual understanding have yet to effectively leverage such graph-structured information in MLLMs. To address these challenges, we introduce Fine-Grained Multimodal Scene Graph Benchmark (FG-GraphBench) and FiGRA. FG-GraphBench is a benchmark comprising three complementary tasks: fine-grained visual question answering (FG-QA), image captioning (FG-Caption), and image description generation (FG-Description). translated_title: FG-GraphBench：基于多模态场景图进行细粒度视觉理解的基准测试与增强
translated_abstract: 细粒度视觉理解要求多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能够识别微小的视觉实体并理解它们之间的关系。场景图为表示这类信息提供了一种自然的方式，它将视觉实体组织为节点，将其之间的关系组织为边。然而，我们发现了两个挑战：现有场景图基准对细粒度实体及其之间关系的覆盖不足，且现有的细粒度视觉理解方法尚未在多模态大语言模型中有效利用这种图结构信息。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了细粒度多模态场景图基准和 FiGRA。FG-GraphBench 是一个包含三个互补任务的基准：细粒度视觉问答（FG-QA）、图像描述生成（FG-Caption）和图像内容描述生成（FG-Description）。我们开发了一个两阶段的构建流水线……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了细粒度多模态场景图基准 FG-GraphBench（涵盖细粒度视觉问答、图像描述与内容描述三个任务）及 FiGRA 方法，以提升多模态大语言模型利用场景图结构信息进行细粒度视觉理解的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FG-GraphBench, a fine-grained multimodal scene graph benchmark with three complementary tasks, and FiGRA, to enhance MLLMs' fine-grained visual understanding by leveraging graph-structured scene information.
